svg.title: MAST shot 21978 normalised-flux contours and divertor-coil pockets
svg.desc: A full R-Z contour map and an absolute-Z divertor zoom show one nested axis-connected plasma family and two closed off-axis flux pockets beside the P2 divertor coils. Four lobe nodes are quoted. Reusing the boundary-level one-fill footprint, not plasma nestedness, is the extraction defect.
svg.text: one closed contour surrounds the axis
two closed contours surround off-axis pockets
The plasma contour family is nested.
Invalid rule: reuse the boundary one-fill
axis-connected; four lobe nodes do not.
